FLINK-5552.title: Introduce JVM-wide JMX server
FLINK-5552.description:
Currently, JMXReporter will create a server for JMX viewer retrieving JMX stat. The port can be configured through configuration options, but for large cluster with many machines running many Flink instances and other processes, we cant set a fixed port to JMX server, making it difficult to get the JMX port.

This JIRA is to suggest adding an api at web frontend so that it is very easy to get the JMX port for JM and TM.

FLINK-18449.title: Make topic discovery and partition discovery configurable for FlinkKafkaConsumer in Table API
FLINK-18449.description:
In streaming api, we can use regex to find topic and enable partiton discovery by setting non-negative value for `{{flink.partition-discovery.interval-millis}}`. However, it's not work in table api. We propose the following new connector options:


{code}
'topic' = 'topic'                                // for single topic
'topic' = 'topic-1, topic-2,..., topic-n',       // for list topic
'topic-pattern' = 'topic*'                       // for use of regex,  "topic" and "topic-pattern" can't coexist
'scan.topic-partition-discovery.interval' = '5s'  // for both topic discovery
{code}

commits.message: [FLINK-18449][kafka][table] Support topic list and topic pattern and partition discovery for Kafka source in Table API
commits.author: fsk119

FLINK-19002.title: Support to only read changelogs of specific database and table for canal-json format
FLINK-19002.description:
Usually, users use Canal to synchronize binlog data from various MySQL databases and tables into a single Kafka topic. However, currently, canal-json can't support this case, because it requires the canal data in the topic should be in the same data format. 

This issue propose to introduce a new option "canal-json.database" and "canal-json.table" to filter out the specific data. It would be great to support table list or table pattern in case of all the tables have the same schema.

commits.message: [FLINK-19002][canal][json] Support to only read changelogs of specific database and table for canal-json format
commits.author: wuchong
